In importlib mode, import_path always creates a brand-new module via module_from_spec and exec_module, and overwrites sys.modules[module_name]. It never checks whether the module is already in sys.modules. Importing the same file twice therefore gives two different module objects. This is why pmxbot.logging ends up duplicated. The branch has no reuse check and no normal-import fallback.
